title: Inter: the papers printed 14 claims this week — one held up
caption:
Inter's papers printed 14 claims this week and the club has confirmed exactly one. L'Équipe had Andy Diouf starting at left back for France — per Inter.it he never left the bench. FCInterNews got its count of thirteen players away with their countries right. Two papers gave Djed Spence a return date; he still has not played a minute.
